children: Overview
US biotech firm's Q3 net loss widened, driven by higher non-cash warrant liability loss
R&D expenses fell while SG&A expenses rose ahead of VOCERYQ commercial launch
Company raised $80.5 mln in public offering to support VOCERYQ launch
Outlook
Company expects full commercial launch of VOCERYQ in Q1 2027
INOVIO estimates current cash will support operations into late fourth qtr 2027
Company plans to submit VOCERYQ conditional marketing authorization application in Europe before end of 2026
Result Drivers
VOCERYQ LAUNCH PREPARATIONS - SG&A expenses increased due to anticipated commercial launch of VOCERYQ
LOWER R&D SPENDING - R&D expenses declined mainly due to reduced engineering services and lower compensation costs
NON-CASH WARRANT LOSS - Net loss widened mainly due to a $26.9 mln non-cash loss from the fair-value adjustment of warrant liabilities
